title: Kosovo Police warn of fake email in the name of the police and acting director Fehmi Hoti
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its own publication.
summary: Ekonomia Online reports a fraudulent email is circulating in the name of the Kosovo Police and the Kosovo Agency for Cyber Security, with the subject 'Raport: Krim Kibernetik/Droga të Paligjshme'. It accuses recipients of illegal online activity and threatens arrest. Kosovo Police say the document was not issued by the institution or by acting director Fehmi Hoti, and urge people not to reply or act on it.
plain: Kosovo Police say a fake email using their name and the acting director's threatens recipients with arrest. They say it is not theirs and urge people not to reply.
exec: Kosovo Police say a fraudulent email using their name and the acting director's is circulating; they urge people not to reply or act on it.
action: Kosovo Police urge citizens not to reply to such emails and not to act on their content.

validation.note: One publisher (Ekonomia Online) read, quoting the police statement. Telegrafi's article on a similar police warning returned HTTP 402 and could not be read.
